Guided by a UNESCO-aligned heritage ontology and verified through rigorous human annotation, the dataset ensures linguistic quality and factual consistency. Evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs reveal that while top models exceed human performance on average, substantial task-level variation emerges: models excel at visual recognition but struggle with culturally grounded reasoning. Performance also varies by dynasty and region. ChinaHeritaQA reveals that strong visual retrieval does not extend to cultural and historical understanding. We release the dataset to support future research on culturally aware multimodal learning.

</details>


### [136] [EPS3D: End-to-End Feed-Forward 3D Panoptic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08980)
*Runsong Zhu,Jiaxin Guo,Xiaoyang Guo,Zhengzhe Liu,Ka-Hei Hui,Wei Yin,Kai Chen,Wei Chen,Weiqiang Ren,Yunhui Liu,Pheng-Ann Heng,Chi-Wing Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EPS3D是一个端到端的前馈框架，用于开放词汇的3D全景分割，通过蒸馏训练策略和多视图图像预测3D感知的语义和实例特征，并设计了语义-实例一致性增强模块，在多个基准测试上取得了SOTA性能，效率高达每场景1秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D全景分割方法依赖额外的预处理步骤（如点云生成），导致误差累积和3D一致性差，且缺乏端到端的解决方案。

Method: 设计端到端架构，采用蒸馏训练策略从多视图图像预测3D感知的语义和实例特征；提出互增强模块，通过Ins2Sem（实例内对齐语义）和Sem2Ins（语义引导细化实例特征）实现语义-实例一致性。

Result: 在Replica基准上语义mIoU提升13%，每场景处理时间仅1秒，优于现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: EPS3D有效提升了开放词汇3D全景分割的准确性和效率，可支持机器人操作和3D场景编辑等下游任务。

Abstract: This paper introduces EPS3D, a new end-to-end feed-forward framework for open-vocabulary 3D panoptic segmentation. Unlike existing methods relying on additional preprocessing, we design an end-to-end architecture, with a distillation-based training strategy on diverse 3D scenes to predict 3D-aware semantic and instance features from multi-view images, improving 3D consistency and avoiding error accumulation. We further propose a mutual enhancement module to enforce inherent semantic-instance consistency. By aligning semantics within instances (Ins2Sem) and refining instance features with semantic guidance (Sem2Ins), we achieve more coherent 3D scene understanding. Ultimately, EPS3D outperforms SOTA baselines on two benchmarks (e.g., +13% mIoU for semantics on Replica) with high efficiency (e.g., 1s per scene), supporting tasks like robotic manipulation and 3D scene editing.

</details>


### [137] [Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09009)
*Leiyu Wang,Zhaofengnian Wang,Xueqi Li,Luoyi Fan,Cewu Lu,Nanyang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SyVLA通过意图解耦算法将控制相关特征与推理上下文分离，并结合相似样本引导的强化学习管道来稳定策略更新，在真实机器人任务中实现了更高的任务成功率和更强的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实部署中面临高层推理与低层控制纠缠不清、以及策略优化不稳定的挑战。

Method: 提出意图解耦（Intention Decoupling）算法，将控制相关特征从推理上下文中分离；提出相似样本引导的强化学习（similar-sample guided RL）管道，稳定策略更新并缓解分布偏移。

Result: 在真实机器人任务和多模态基准测试中，SyVLA相比现有方法取得了更高的任务成功率和更强的分布外泛化能力，同时有效保留了核心视觉-语言能力。

Conclusion: 通过解耦控制与推理、引入多样化经验训练，SyVLA能够构建更鲁棒的VLA模型，兼顾任务性能与泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models face significant challenges in real-world deployment due to the entanglement of high-level reasoning with low-level control, and the instability of policy optimization. In this paper, we introduce SyVLA, a robust VLA model trained with diversified experiences. We propose an Intention Decoupling algorithm to isolate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to stabilize policy updates and mitigate distribution shift. Extensive experiments on real-world robotic tasks and multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that SyVLA achieves superior task success rates and stronger out-of-distribution generalization compared to existing methods, while effectively preserving core vision-language capabilities. Codes and Datasets is released on \href{https://sy-vla.github.io/}{project page}.

</details>


### [138] [ATM: Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for Diagnosing and Improving Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09028)
*Jiaheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ATM（动作一致性迁移矩阵），通过轻量级探针比较真实编码转移与模型预测转移中的动作信息，诊断潜在世界模型的动作语义保持能力，无需仿真器 rollout 即可评估表征质量，实现超过100倍的速度提升；同时提出AITS，将动作可识别性作为训练信号改进下游规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型的评估依赖于与规划器耦合的仿真器评估（如CEM），这种评估方式不仅速度慢（分钟到小时级），而且是黑箱的、依赖模型复杂度，无法高效诊断模型表征质量。

Method: 提出ATM（动作一致性迁移矩阵）：在编码的真实转移和模型预测的转移上训练轻量级post-hoc探针，比较其中的动作信息，生成可解释的矩阵来揭示表征质量、转移域不一致性和失败模式。还提出AITS，将动作可识别性用作训练信号。

Result: ATM在真实成功差距显著时实现高度可靠的成对排名，将分钟到小时的CEM评估缩短为秒级转移分析，实现超过100倍的加速。AITS证明动作可识别性不仅可用于诊断，还可作为改善下游规划的训练信号。

Conclusion: ATM提供了一种高效、可解释的潜在世界模型诊断方法，无需仿真器评估即可评估表征质量；AITS进一步表明动作可识别性可作为有用的训练信号提升规划性能。

Abstract: Latent world models are increasingly used for control and goal-conditioned planning, yet assessing whether their learned representations are useful for planning usually requires slow, planner-coupled simulator evaluation with CEM or similar planners. Such evaluation is black-box and model-complexity-dependent: under the same protocol, different world models may require minutes to hours per checkpoint. In this work, we propose ATM, an Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for diagnosing whether latent transitions preserve action semantics relevant to planning. ATM compares action information in real encoded transitions and model-predicted transitions through lightweight post-hoc probes, producing an interpretable matrix that reveals representation quality, transition-domain inconsistency, and failure modes without simulator rollout. It can also be collapsed into a simple screening score for within-task ranking across checkpoints, variants, and world models. When the true success gap is non-trivial, ATM achieves highly reliable pairwise ranking, while reducing minutes-to-hours CEM evaluation to seconds-level transition analysis, yielding more than 100x speedup in our setup. We further introduce AITS, showing that action-identifiability is not only diagnostic but also a useful training signal for improving downstream planning without changing the planner.

</details>


### [139] [Frequency Decoupled Framework for Screen Content Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09029)
*Xufei Wang,Qicheng Zhang,Qi Wu,Ziyang Gu,Shizhuang Weng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频率解耦框架(FDF)，通过幅值-相位分解和隐式神经表示，实现屏幕内容图像超分辨率，在四个数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于隐式神经表示的SCISR方法忽略了图像固有的频率特性，导致性能次优。

Method: FDF包含两个核心模块：(1) 幅值-相位分解网络(APFN)将图像分解为幅值和相位流，幅值聚类模块(ACM)组织稀疏高能幅值响应为代表性原型以提取周期模式，相位一致性自注意力(PCSA)通过连续一致性传播强化配置；(2) 振荡-非谐波隐式拟合网络(OAIF-Net)整合周期性和相干性隐式表示，高效利用SCI中的周期模式与相干上下文。

Result: 在四个公开SCI数据集上，多尺度超分辨率实验均达到SOTA性能；消融实验验证了各组件在提取和利用周期模式与相干上下文方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 从相位量视角重新审视SCISR，通过显式建模幅值结构能量与相位关系连续性，结合定制隐式表示，能够忠实恢复SCI的规则纹理和全局配置。

Abstract: Methods based on implicit neural representations have demonstrated superior performance in Screen Content Image Super-Resolution (SCISR) . However, they overlooked the inherent frequency characteristics, leading to suboptimal performance. We propose a frequency decoupled framework (FDF) that rethinks SCISR from a phasor perspective by capturing structured energy in amplitude and relational continuity in phase, and jointly exploiting them with bespoke implicit representations to faithfully recover the regular textures and global configuration of Screen Content Image (SCI).
  Amplitude-Phase Factorization Network (APFN) first separates images into amplitude and phase streams, where Amplitude Clustering Module (ACM) organizes sparse yet high-energy amplitude responses into representative prototypes for periodic pattern extraction, while Phase Consistency Self-Attention (PCSA) progressively reinforces configuration through continuous consistency propagation.
  And Oscillation-Anharmonic Implicit Fitting Network (OAIF-Net) integrates periodic and coherent implicit representations for efficient exploitation of the periodic patterns and coherent context embedded in SCI.
  Experimental results show FDF achieves state-of-the-art SCISR performance at multiple scales across four public SCI datasets. Ablation experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of each component in extracting and exploiting periodic patterns and coherent context.

</details>


### [140] [CRANE: Knowledge Editing for Reasoning MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09033)
*Han Huang,Hao Wang,Mengqi Zhang,Shu Wu,Qiang Liu,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了推理型多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在知识编辑中存在的三大失败模式（结构崩溃、认知失调、浅层内化），并提出了一种免参数修改的检索增强框架CRANE，通过模态感知双库检索与认知路由奖励训练，在冲突场景下达到96.9%的Grounded Success。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的知识编辑方法在推理型MLLMs中存在严重的隐蔽失效问题——在传统指标（如教师强制准确率）下看似成功（可达100%），但在模型实际推理过程中却完全失败（Grounded Success低至0%）。现有评估协议未能暴露这些缺陷，亟需新的评估框架和解决方案。

Method: （1）提出CoT感知的评估协议ReasonEdit-Bench，包含冲突分层、多级探针和多跳可移植性测试；（2）提出CRANE框架，采用模态感知双库检索系统，结合两阶段训练：SFT进行结构初始化，GRPO配合认知路由奖励训练模型在视觉先验与注入编辑事实间进行仲裁。

Result: 在ReasonEdit-Bench上，CRANE在冲突场景下Grounded Success达96.9%，多跳链中中间实体使用率达96.9%，文本局部性97.6%，图像局部性编辑独立性68.1%；在OOD基准MMEVOKE上，黄金检索下达87.0%。

Conclusion: 推理型MLLMs的知识编辑面临传统方法无法解决的独特挑战，检索增强策略（如CRANE）相比参数修改方法更具优势，能够同时保证推理格式完整性、事实准确性和泛化能力。

Abstract: The emergence of reasoning multimodal large language models (MLLMs), which generate explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before producing answers, has introduced a new challenge for knowledge editing: methods that appear successful under traditional metrics (teacher-forcing accuracy up to 100%) can fail severely when the model's reasoning process is examined (Grounded Success as low as 0%). We identify three failure modes: (1) Structural Collapse, where weight-modifying methods destroy the CoT format; (2) Cognitive Dissonance, where the model's reasoning chain actively rejects the injected edit fact based on visual evidence; and (3) Shallow Internalization, where methods succeed on exact queries but fail on rephrase or multi-hop variants. On reasoning MLLMs, these modes interact: methods that generalize (FT, LoRA) trigger format collapse, while methods without deep modification cannot generalize. To expose these failures, we propose a CoT-aware evaluation protocol and construct ReasonEdit-Bench, with conflict stratification, multi-level probes, and multi-hop portability tests.
  We propose CRANE, a retrieval-augmented framework that requires no per-edit parameter modification. CRANE combines a modality-aware dual-library retrieval system with a two-phase training strategy: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for structural initialization, followed by GRPO with a Cognitive Routing Reward that trains the model to arbitrate between visual priors and injected edit facts. On ReasonEdit-Bench, CRANE achieves 96.9% Grounded Success on conflict scenarios and 96.9% intermediate entity usage in multi-hop chains, with 97.6% text-locality and 68.1% image-locality Edit Independence. On the out-of-distribution MMEVOKE benchmark, CRANE reaches 87.0% under gold retrieval.

</details>


### [141] [Leveraging NeRF-Rendered Images for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09034)
*Mizuki Morikawa,Yuta Shimizu,Chunyu Li,Yusuke Monno,Masatoshi Okutomi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用NeRF渲染图像辅助3DGS训练，在城市场景中去除瞬态物体并生成鸟瞰视角，从而在保持3DGS渲染速度的同时提升渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NeRF和3DGS在新视角合成任务中表现互补：3DGS渲染速度快但质量较低，NeRF渲染质量高但速度慢。作者希望结合二者优势，在保持3DGS快速渲染能力的同时提升其渲染质量。

Method: 使用预训练的街景NeRF方法生成训练图像，将其用于目标3DGS的训练：1）利用NeRF渲染图像去除输入视角中的瞬态物体；2）生成鸟瞰视角作为额外训练视角，将NeRF的高质量渲染继承到3DGS中；3）引入基于扩散模型的图像增强技术提升额外视角的图像质量。

Result: 在一个合成数据集和两个真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持3DGS渲染速度和NeRF渲染质量的同时，提升了街景渲染效果。

Conclusion: 通过NeRF渲染图像辅助3DGS训练，能够有效融合两种方法的优势，在城市场景中实现速度与质量兼得的新视角合成。

Abstract: Neural radiance field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) are two mainstream approaches for novel view synthesis. They often show complementary performance, i.e., 3DGS demonstrating faster rendering speed and NeRF demonstrating higher rendering quality. Motivated by this, we propose leveraging NeRF-rendered images for 3DGS. Specifically, we target street scenes and utilize a pre-trained street-specific NeRF method to produce training images for a target 3DGS method. In our 3DGS training, NeRF-rendered images are used to remove transient objects in street-level input views and to generate bird's-eye views as additional views, inheriting the higher-quality rendering of NeRF into 3DGS. We further incorporate a diffusion-based image enhancement to improve the image quality of the additional views. Experimental results on one synthetic and two real datasets demonstrate that our proposed method improves street-scene rendering while preserving the speed of 3DGS and the quality of NeRF.

</details>


### [142] [MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09056)
*Ishaan Preetam Chandratreya,David Charatan,Basile Van Hoorick,Sergey Zakharov,Vitor Guizilini,Phillip Isola,Vincent Sitzmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多尺度token空间的粗到细展开方法，通过分层自编码器将视频帧压缩为不同粒度的token，并训练视频扩散模型逐步生成这些token，从而在不增加计算负担的情况下实现视频长程一致性，在Minecraft数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以实现长程一致性，因为即使生成几十帧也需要过长的Transformer序列长度，计算成本不切实际。

Method: 1) 预训练分层自编码器，将每帧压缩为从典型潜变量分辨率到极少量token的层次化表示；2) 训练视频扩散模型，按照粗到细的方式逐级生成token，在每一展开步骤中精细控制帧生成细节级别和上下文使用范围。

Result: 在长Minecraft视频数据集上，该方法相比现有基线生成了更一致的展开结果，在几何一致性和物体恒存性方面表现显著提升。

Conclusion: 粗到细的多尺度token展开方法能有效解决视频生成长程一致性问题，通过将计算资源优先分配给感知上更重要的高层语义信息，在保证一致性的同时节省了计算开销。

Abstract: Video generative models have become increasingly powerful, but long-range consistency remains challenging to achieve because even a few dozen frames require impractically long transformer sequence lengths. We show that this issue can be mitigated by generating video using coarse-to-fine rollout within a multi-scale token space. Our approach is simple: first, we pre-train an autoencoder that compresses each frame into a hierarchy of tokens, with levels ranging from the typical latent resolution to only a handful of tokens per frame. The coarsest levels capture the most consequential information, such as scene layout and semantics, while finer levels add high-frequency appearance and texture. Then, we train a video diffusion model to generate these tokens using coarse-to-fine rollout. By carefully controlling the level of detail at which frames are generated and used as context during each rollout step, we are able to preserve long-range consistency in geometry and object permanence while spending less compute on the long-range consistency of less perceptually relevant details. We validate this approach using a custom dataset of long Minecraft videos, where it produces substantially more consistent rollouts compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [143] [See More, Think Deeper: Query-Expanded Visual Evidence and Answer-Clue Guided Reflection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09064)
*Shuning Wang,Zhiheng Wu,YiNuo Lu,Naiming Liu,Chen Jia,Bowen Liu,Shuo Nie,Weijie Zhu,Yumeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CoVER框架，通过动态查询扩展收集视觉证据（See More）和答案特定视觉反馈验证（Think Deeper），将长视频理解从以答案为中心转变为以证据为中心的视觉可验证推理，在多个基准上显著超越同参数量模型甚至部分闭源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Video-LLM在长视频理解中存在两个关键局限：证据获取依赖单一搜索意图，答案生成缺乏有效的视觉反馈机制。

Method: CoVER框架包含两个核心机制：1）See More：通过动态查询扩展收集更全面的视觉证据；2）Think Deeper：通过答案特定的视觉反馈验证草稿答案，实现视觉可验证推理。

Result: CoVER-7B显著优于同参数量模型，并在某些指标上超越最先进的闭源模型。

Conclusion: 长视频理解应从以答案为中心的生成范式转向以证据为中心且可视觉验证的推理范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have enabled performance on long-video understanding tasks. However, existing methods still face two key limitations: evidence acquisition often relies on a single search intent, and answer generation lacks an effective visual feedback mechanism. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{CoVER}, a Comprehensive Visual Evidence and Reflection framework for long-video understanding. CoVER enables Video-LLMs to \textbf{See More} by dynamically gathering query-expanded visual evidence, and \textbf{Think Deeper} by verifying draft answers with effective answer-specific visual feedback. Together, these mechanisms shift long-video understanding from answer-centric generation to evidence-centric and visually verifiable reasoning. Experimental results show that CoVER-7B substantially outperforms models with the same parameter scale and even surpasses state-of-the-art closed-source models on certain metrics.

</details>


### [144] [REFINE: Super-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09074)
*Zhang Chen,Shuai Wan,Mengting Yu,Fuzheng Yang,Junhui Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REFINE提出了一种基于可微渲染感知Hessian场的3D高斯泼溅快速剪枝方法，通过解析近似替代昂贵的正向渲染，实现3000倍剪枝计算加速且保持高质量渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝方法要么质量严重下降，要么计算开销过高，亟需一种既高效又保质的剪枝方案。

Method: 提出渲染无关的图元重要性度量，通过解析近似的渲染感知Hessian场量化移除单个图元带来的感知误差，联合建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数，导出各向异性感知权重场作为图元重要性的高保真代理，完全绕过前向渲染。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，REFINE保持极具竞争力的渲染质量，同时相比SOTA剪枝方法实现了3000倍的剪枝相关计算复杂度降低。

Conclusion: REFINE通过解析近似Hessian场实现了极高效的3DGS剪枝，在质量与效率之间取得了显著优于现有方法的平衡。

Abstract: Existing pruning methods for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) suffer from either severe quality degradation or prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we propose REFINE, a highly accelerated 3DGS pruning framework centered on a novel rendering-free primitive importance metric. Our approach leverages an analytically approximated, rendering-aware Hessian field to quantify the expected perceptual error induced by the removal of individual primitives. By modeling the joint modulation of visibility, projection geometry and the content adaptive hyperparameter, we entirely bypass costly forward rendering passes and derive an anisotropic perceptual weight field that serves as a high-fidelity proxy for primitive importance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that REFINE maintains highly competitive rendering quality while achieving an unprecedented $3,000\times$ reduction in pruning-related computational complexity compared to state-of-the-art pruning methods.

</details>


### [145] [Beyond Scalar Rewards by Internalizing Reasoning into Score Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09076)
*Xin Jin,Huanqia Cai,Zhen Li,Zechao Zhan,Dengyang Jiang,Aiming Hao,Yuming Jiang,Chunle Guo,Peng Gao,Ming-Ming Cheng,Steven C. H. Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Z-Reward师生奖励建模框架，通过大VLM教师进行推理式评分分布预测（GDSO训练），再由紧凑VLM学生通过RISD蒸馏实现高效部署，无需推理链即可作为可微分奖励信号用于文生图后训练，在偏好准确率和优化效果上均显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉偏好本质上是主观且多维的，现有标量、分数token或成对奖励模型过度压缩了不确定性和细粒度分数差异，而基于推理的生成式奖励虽判断力强但部署成本高且难以作为直接优化信号。

Method: 提出Z-Reward师生框架：教师为大VLM，采用Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO)联合策略梯度奖励与点态/成对监督学习推理驱动的评分分布；学生通过Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD)将教师的推理条件评分分布蒸馏为紧凑VLM，推理时无需显式推理链。

Result: 27B GDSO教师达到89.6%人类偏好准确率，超越SFT、RewardDance和GRPO；9B RISD学生达到88.6%，超越OPD基线且接近大教师；作为可微分奖励信号用于文生图优化，较SFT基线提升41.3%净人类偏好。

Conclusion: Z-Reward成功解耦了推理型判断与高效奖励部署，证明基于分布建模的师生蒸馏框架既能保持强判断力又能实现低成本推理，并可作为有效的可微分优化信号。

Abstract: Reward models are central to text-to-image post-training, but visual preference is subjective and better represented as a distribution over rubric scores than as a deterministic scalar. Existing scalar, score-token, and pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards provide stronger judgments but are costly to deploy and difficult to use as direct optimization signals. We propose Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward modeling framework that decouples reasoning-heavy judgment from efficient reward deployment. The teacher is a large VLM that uses reasoning to infer rubric-aligned score distributions, and is trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO), which combines policy-gradient rewards from distribution expectations with direct pointwise and pairwise supervision on score distributions and score gaps. The student is trained with Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD), which transfers the teacher's reasoning-conditioned score distribution into a compact VLM without requiring explicit reasoning chains at inference time. On our internally annotated evaluation set, the 27B GDSO teacher reaches 89.6% human preference accuracy, outperforming SFT, RewardDance, and GRPO, while the 9B RISD student reaches 88.6%, outperforming the OPD baseline and closely matching the larger teacher. We further show that Z-Reward can serve as a differentiable reward signal for text-to-image optimization, yielding a 41.3% net human-preference improvement over the SFT baseline.

</details>


### [146] [Edge-Constrained UAV Small-Object Detection with P2 Enhancement and Quantum-Inspired Lightweight Structure Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09081)
*Wuming Lei,Yanbin Gao,Mingyan Sun,Xiaobin Li,Xuechen Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对无人机目标检测中的小目标检测难题，在YOLOX-Nano基础上引入P2高分辨率检测分支并结合量子启发进化算法(QIEA)进行轻量化结构筛选。实验表明，P2分支在VisDrone数据集上将小目标AP提升31.10%，QIEA筛选的候选在召回率上表现最优，但P2分支在完整训练后仍是AP最优变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量级网络反复下采样会削弱浅层空间信息，导致小目标细节丢失；手动添加注意力或融合模块可能增加计算成本且收益不稳定。亟需一种在边缘部署约束下兼顾精度、运算量、延迟和内存的小目标检测优化方案。

Method: 以YOLOX-Nano为基础，引入P2高分辨率检测分支增强小目标特征；利用量子启发进化算法(QIEA)在轻量优先和任务特定性定义的搜索空间中进行结构筛选；联合评估指标包括精度、FLOPs、延迟、内存消耗和召回率。

Result: 在VisDrone数据集上，P2分支使AP_small提升31.10%；与相似模型大小的NanoDet-Plus相比，AP_s0.5提升17.5%，AP_small提升44.9%；QIEA筛选的候选召回率最高，但+P2在完整训练后AP最优；代理排序不能保证迁移到最终AP。

Conclusion: P2高分辨率分支可作为小目标增强的主要路径，QIEA可作为轻量级候选筛选和精度-成本分析的有效工具。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object detection requires compact detectors that retain small-object details under onboard computation and memory constraints. Repeated downsampling inlightweight networks weakens shallow spatial information, while manually adding attention orfusion modules may increase cost without stable gains. This study analyzes YOLOX-Nano underedge-deployment constraints by combining a P2 high-resolution detection branch with a quantum-inspired evolutionary algorithm (QIEA) for lightweight structure screening. The search space isdefined by lightweight priority and task specificity, and the evaluation jointly considers accuracy,floating-point operations (FLOPs), latency, memory consumption, and recall. On VisDrone, theP2 branch increases APamall by 31.10% over the YOLOX-Nano baseline. Compared with NanoDet-Plus with similar model size, YOLOX-Nano+-P2 improves APs0.ss by 17.5% and APamal by 44.9%.The QIEA-selected candidate obtains the highest Recallso, but +P2 remains the strongest AP-oriented variant after full training. Full 100-epoch verification of Random-best, GA-best, andSA/QUBO-best candidates further shows that proxy rankings do not necessarily transfer to finalAPse9s. These results support using P2 as the main small-object enhancement path and QIEA as alightweight tool for candidate screening and accuracy-cost analysis. The source code, configurationfiles, diagnostic scripts, and summarized results are available at https://github.com/Ming23233/UAV-QIEA-Edge-Detection

</details>


### [147] [Driving Video Retrieval for Complex Queries with Structured Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09109)
*Manyi Yao,Sparsh Garg,Christian Shelton,Amit Roy-Chowdhury,Abhishek Aich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STRIVE-D框架，通过数据校准的规则检索与视觉-语言及关键词检索融合，在自动驾驶视频检索中提升动态事件（如切入、急刹车）的检索准确率，最高提升84%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言和关键词检索方法因文本中未明确描述运动信息而遗漏动态事件，基于规则的检索虽能直接编码事件但过于脆弱，规则假设常与真实驾驶数据不匹配。

Method: 使用弱标注的领域内视频估计查询规则的可靠性，自适应调整与观测数据不匹配的规则，并将校准后的规则分数与视觉-语言及关键词检索信号融合。

Result: 在三个驾驶基准上，包括DrivingDojo新发布的人工标注事件数据，STRIVE-D将top-1准确率相对提升最多84%。

Conclusion: 数据校准的规则融合策略能有效弥补纯文本检索在动态事件上的不足，提升自动驾驶视频检索的实用性。

Abstract: Video retrieval at scale is central to data curation and safety validation in autonomous driving, where users want to find not only scenes but also dynamic events such as cut-ins and hard braking. Existing vision-language and keyword-based retrieval methods often miss these events because the relevant motion may not be explicitly described in text or captured by lexical overlap. Rule-based retrieval can encode such events more directly, but it is brittle: generated or hand-written rules often fail when their assumptions do not match real driving data. We propose STRIVE-D, a data-calibrated retrieval framework for driving videos. It uses weakly labeled in-domain videos to estimate when a query rule is reliable, adapt rules that mismatch observed data, and fuse calibrated rule scores with vision-language and keyword-based retrieval signals. Across three driving benchmarks, including newly released human-annotated event data on DrivingDojo, STRIVE-D delivers up to 84% relative improvement in top-1 accuracy over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [148] [HDRAgent: An Agentic Framework for Multi-Exposure HDR Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09110)
*Weiyu Zhou,Tao Hu,Yijian Wang,Xiaogang Xu,Ruixing Wang,Qingsen Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HDRAgent，首个基于智能体的HDR成像框架，通过多模态大模型驱动的场景感知、上下文知识匹配和反馈机制，自适应选择重建策略，有效减少动态场景中的鬼影伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数多曝光HDR方法遵循固定的前馈重建范式，在复杂动态场景中容易产生鬼影伪影，缺乏根据场景条件自适应调整策略的能力。

Method: 1) 细粒度上下文知识匹配(FCM)模块，利用MLLM的场景感知检索历史案例和工具知识；2) 感知-失真反馈机制，将质量评估和伪影诊断转化为结构化反馈累积到历史记忆中；3) 智能体引导的生成式对齐策略，利用MLLM动态区域解析在参考帧指导下重建非参考帧中不可靠内容。

Result: 有效减少鬼影和局部伪影，在客观性能和视觉质量上达到竞争性或更优水平。

Conclusion: 基于智能体的自适应框架能够突破传统固定范式局限，为复杂动态场景下的HDR成像提供更鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Most existing multi-exposure HDR methods follow a fixed feed-forward reconstruction paradigm, making them prone to ghosting artifacts in complex dynamic scenes. To address this issue, we propose HDRAgent, the first agent-driven framework for HDR imaging, which adaptively selects reconstruction strategies according to the current scene conditions. Specifically, to provide scene-specific prior knowledge, we introduce a fine-grained contextual knowledge matching (FCM) module. This module leverages multimodal large language model (MLLM)-derived scene perception to retrieve relevant historical cases and tool knowledge, organizing them into structured evidence for MLLM-based adaptive tool scheduling. In addition, we propose a perception--distortion feedback mechanism that transforms post-execution quality assessment and artifact diagnosis into structured feedback, which is accumulated in historical memory to help subsequent contextual knowledge refinement and strategy selection. Furthermore, considering that extreme motion can invalidate alignment methods, we design an agent-guided generative alignment strategy that uses MLLM-based dynamic-region parsing to reconstruct unreliable contents in non-reference frames under reference-frame guidance. Experiments demonstrate that HDRAgent effectively reduces ghosting and local artifacts while achieving competitive or superior objective performance and visual quality.

</details>


### [149] [Illumination-Invariant Anomaly Detection for Sub-Canopy UAV Multispectral Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09111)
*Likun Chen,Yanfeng Gu,Xian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无先验的无人机多光谱点云异常检测框架，通过逆优化太阳角估计实现无先验阴影提取，并结合光照一致性稀疏表示机制消除光谱畸变，显著提升了复杂森林环境下异常目标与背景的可分离性，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机多光谱点云在亚冠层目标检测中受植被阴影导致的严重光照异质性影响，现有方法依赖飞行元数据且无法有效区分暗目标与真实阴影，需一种无需先验知识且鲁棒处理光照变化的异常检测框架。

Method: 1) 将太阳角估计建模为逆优化问题，耦合光谱指数与光线追踪模型实现无先验阴影提取；2) 引入光照一致性稀疏表示机制，仅从相同光照状态的邻域构建背景字典，解耦光谱反射率与光照变化，确保目标仅由物理一致背景点表示。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了复杂森林环境中异常目标与背景的可分离性，在多个基准测试中优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 该框架特别适用于识别伪装军事目标、测绘倒塌树干以及发现茂密植被下隐藏的考古遗址等场景。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) multispectral point clouds (MPC) provide high-dimensional spatial-spectral data for sub-canopy target detection; however, their efficacy is significantly compromised by severe illumination heterogeneity caused by vegetation shadows. To address this, we propose a prior-free anomaly detection framework capable of robustly handling lighting variations. First, we formulate solar angle estimation as an inverse optimization problem. By coupling spectral indices with a ray-tracing model, this strategy achieves Prior-Free Shadow Extraction without relying on flight metadata, effectively distinguishing dark objects from true shadows. Second, to mitigate spectral distortions, we introduce an Illumination-Consistent Sparse Representation mechanism. Unlike standard reconstruction methods, we construct a background dictionary strictly from neighbors sharing the same illumination state. This constraint effectively disentangles spectral reflectance from lighting variations, ensuring that targets are represented solely by physically consistent background points. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method significantly improves the separability between anomalies and background in complex forest environments, demonstrating superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines. This framework is particularly suited for identifying camouflaged military targets, mapping fallen tree trunks, and uncovering archaeological ruins hidden beneath dense foliage.

</details>


### [150] [An Enhanced Geometric-Spectral Feature Learning Framework for Airborne Multispectral Point Cloud Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09123)
*Xian Li,Yanfeng Gu,Aleksandra Pižurica*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于注意力机制的双流几何-光谱特征融合框架（GSFF），用于机载多光谱点云的土地覆盖分类，通过残差注意力融合模块和联合损失函数解决高维异质特征、样本不均衡和类间相似性问题，在两个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱点云（MPC）包含3D空间-光谱信息，具有巨大的土地覆盖分类潜力，但现有分类模型受限于高维异质空间-光谱信息、样本分布不均衡以及机载MPC的类间光谱相似性，表示能力有限。

Method: 提出了一种增强的几何-光谱特征学习框架，核心组件包括：(1) 双流特征融合方法，第一流使用融合自注意力提取位置编码的全局光谱特征，第二流使用多核点卷积和特征聚合注意力提取光谱引导的几何特征；(2) 残差注意力融合模块整合两个并行流中最具信息量的几何-光谱特征；(3) 联合损失函数改善对不均衡和类间相似样本的学习能力。

Result: 在两个机载MPC数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的基于注意力的几何-光谱特征学习框架能有效处理MPC分类中的高维异质特征、样本不均衡和类间相似性挑战，代码和数据集将公开发布。

Abstract: Multispectral point cloud (MPC) is composed of 3D spatial-spectral information, which holds tremendous potential for accurate land-cover classification. However, the representation power of classification models is limited by inherent high-dimensional and heterogeneous spatial-spectral information, unbalanced sample distribution, and inter-class spectral similarity of airborne MPCs. We build two MPC datasets and propose an enhanced geometric-spectral feature learning framework based on attentions for airborne MPC classification. A key component in our model is a two-stream feature fusion method with attention mechanisms, which enhances the representation capability of spatial-spectral features from high-dimensional heterogeneous MPCs. The first stream aims to extract position-encoded global spectral features with fusion self-attention, and the second stream comprises a multikernel point convolution and feature aggregation attention to extract spectral-guided geometric features. We then develop a residual attention fusion block to integrate the most informative geometric-spectral features from the two parallel streams. Another important contribution of this work is a joint loss function to improve the learning ability on unbalanced and interclass similar samples. Experimental results on two airborne MPC datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with the state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, the codes and datasets used in this paper will be made available freely at https://github.com/HITlixian/TGRS_GSFF.

</details>


### [151] [A Geometric Framework for Absolute Pose and Velocity Estimation with Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09139)
*Zibin Liu,Shunkun Liang,Banglei Guan,Yang Shang,Qifeng Yu,Ji Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机和3D线特征同时估计绝对位姿与速度的几何框架，通过构建事件平面法向量与3D线正交、事件与2D线投影共线两个几何约束，设计了线性/多项式求解器（位姿）和线性/优化求解器（速度），仅需最少3组事件-线对应即可实现6-DoF姿态恢复，在仿真和真实数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于事件的运动估计几何方法主要关注速度估计，而绝对位姿估计（对机器人导航和增强现实等应用至关重要）研究不足，同时从事件流中恢复绝对位姿和速度仍是开放难题。

Method: 利用场景中3D线与其触发的事件之间的两个几何约束：3D线与对应事件平面法向量的正交性、事件与其关联线2D投影的共线性。基于此分别提出绝对位姿估计的线性求解器（高效）和多项式求解器（全局最优旋转），以及速度估计的线性求解器和基于优化的求解器，最少仅需3组事件-线对应。

Result: 在仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精度和计算效率上均达到SOTA水平，显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 提出的几何框架有效填补了事件相机绝对位姿与速度联合估计的空白，提供了高效且精确的解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Despite the rapid advancements in event-based motion estimation, current geometric methods primarily focus on velocity estimation. However, absolute pose estimation, which is equally crucial for key applications such as robotic navigation and augmented reality, remains relatively underexplored. Consequently, the simultaneous recovery of absolute pose and velocity from event streams remains an open and challenging problem. To address this gap, we propose a geometric framework for absolute pose and velocity estimation by leveraging 3D lines in the scene and the events they trigger. At the core of the framework lie two key geometric constraints: the orthogonality between a 3D line and the normal vector of its corresponding event plane, and the collinearity of an event with the 2D projection of its associated line. Based on these constraints, we present both linear and polynomial solvers for absolute pose estimation. The former enables efficient computation, while the latter provides a globally optimal solution for rotation. For velocity estimation, we develop an efficient linear solver and a more accurate optimization-based solver to recover both angular and linear velocities. Notably, our methods require a minimum of three event-line correspondences to determine the 6-DoF absolute pose or velocities independently. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. The demo code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zibin6/EventPoseVelocity.

</details>


### [152] [DiffSight-Former: Modeling Structural Differences and Temporal Dynamics for Glaucoma Progression Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09140)
*Yi Huang,Lei Bi,Jinman Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiffSight-Former框架，利用时序眼底图像预测青光眼进展，通过时间变异性特征提取、多结构差异建模和时间感知Transformer，在SIGF和GRAPE数据集上取得了优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有青光眼进展预测方法多依赖单时间点图像或固定长度输入，未能充分利用纵向随访影像中的时序信息，且难以捕捉早期进展信号，限制了临床应用价值。

Method: DiffSight-Former包含三个核心模块：基于眼底专用基础模型的时间变异性特征提取模块、量化视盘/杯区和视网膜血管多结构差异的建模模块，以及整合时间间隔嵌入的时间感知Transformer。

Result: 在SIGF数据集上AUC达91.54%、灵敏度92.16%；在GRAPE数据集上三种视野进展标准下平均准确率87.48%，在不同时间设置下表现鲁棒。

Conclusion: DiffSight-Former在纵向青光眼监测和早期风险预测方面具有潜力，优于现有方法，且在不同时间设置下表现出强鲁棒性。

Abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness worldwide, and early detection from fundus images is critical for effective disease management. While deep learning has achieved promising performance in fundus image analysis, most existing methods rely on single time-point images and fail to capture longitudinal structural and vascular changes associated with disease progression. Sequential fundus images acquired during clinical follow-up provide valuable temporal information; however, current sequential models often struggle to detect subtle early progression signals and commonly depend on fixed-length inputs or diagnostic cues from already glaucomatous images, limiting their clinical utility for early prediction. To address these limitations, we propose DiffSight-Former, a framework for glaucoma progression prediction from sequential fundus images. It incorporates a time-variant feature extraction module based on a fundus-specific foundation model to obtain robust anatomical representations. A multi-structure difference modeling module is introduced to quantify progression-related changes in the optic disc/cup region and retinal vasculature. These representations are integrated with temporal interval embeddings and processed by a time-aware Transformer to model disease progression and estimate the probability of future glaucoma onset. Experiments were conducted on two longitudinal datasets, SIGF (405 sequences) and GRAPE (263 sequences). On SIGF, DiffSight-Former achieved an AUC of 91.54% and a sensitivity of 92.16% for progression prediction. On GRAPE, it achieved an average accuracy of 87.48% across three clinical visual-field progression criteria. Compared with existing approaches, DiffSight-Former demonstrates strong performance and robustness across different temporal settings, highlighting its potential for longitudinal glaucoma monitoring and early risk prediction.

</details>


### [153] [Decoding Pedestrian Crossing Intention from Egocentric Vision via Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09142)
*Danya Li,Xiang Su,Yan Feng,Rico Krueger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探索利用自我中心视觉和视觉语言模型（VLM）解码行人过街意图。零样本设置下VLM表现有限，通过参数高效微调可显著提升性能，其中结合眼动和自车运动的Qwen3-VL-2B模型相比Transformer基线实现了14.5%的准确率提升，达到新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心视觉在交通安全预测中的潜力尚未充分挖掘，现有方法对行人过街意图的推理能力有限，需要探索基于VLM的高效解码方法。

Method: 将行人意图解码任务建模为闭式视觉问答（VQA）问题，利用VLM进行预测。首先在零样本设置下评估三类SOTA VLM，随后采用参数高效微调（PEFT）使模型适应目标任务，并引入自车运动、车辆运动、眼动等额外上下文线索提升性能。

Result: 零样本VLM仅略优于随机猜测；微调后模型显著超越零样本版本，并比专用Transformer基线提升9%准确率。结合眼动和自车运动的Qwen3-VL-2B微调模型取得14.5%的准确率提升，达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: 基于VLM的微调方法能有效解码行人过街意图，引入额外上下文线索（尤其是眼动和自车运动）可进一步提升预测精度，验证了自我中心视觉与VLM结合在交通安全领域的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Egocentric vision offers a first-person view of human perception and decision making, yet its potential for traffic-safety prediction remains underexplored. In this work, we study the decoding of pedestrian crossing intentions from short egocentric video clips. We approach this by formulating the task as a closed-ended visual question answering (VQA) problem and leveraging vision language models (VLMs) to predict the pedestrians' intent. We first benchmark three families of state-of-the-art VLMs in a zero-shot setting, finding that they achieve moderate gains over random guessing but exhibit limited higher-level traffic reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we further adapt VLMs to the target task using parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Our results show that the fine-tuned models substantially outperform their zero-shot counterparts and achieve a 9\% accuracy improvement over a specialized transformer-based baseline. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating additional contextual cues, including ego motion, vehicle motion, and eye gaze, further improves predictive performance. In particular, the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B model guided by eye gaze and ego motion achieves a 14.5% accuracy improvement over the transformer baseline, establishing a new state of the art for egocentric pedestrian intent decoding.

</details>


### [154] [CAMF-Det: Closure-Aware Multimodal Fusion for LiDAR-Camera 3D Object Detection on UAV Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09143)
*Yanze Jiang,Yanfeng Gu,Xian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对无人机平台多模态3D检测中地面物体被树冠遮挡导致信息退化的问题，提出CAMF-Det框架，通过基于Beer-Lambert定律的物理建模显式构建双模态遮挡强度先验，并将其注入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合和检测头，在自建数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR-相机多模态3D检测方法在地面车辆场景表现优异，但未针对无人机平台探索。无人机俯拍场景中，以树冠遮挡为主的频繁地面物体遮挡导致空间变化且模态依赖的信息退化，现有融合框架未能显式建模该遮挡或将其嵌入检测流程。

Method: 提出CAMF-Det框架：1) 双模态遮挡建模模块：基于Beer-Lambert定律物理启发公式和建筑掩码校正，离线构建双模态遮挡强度真值图；2) 双模态预测网络：以真值图监督，将离线建模转为单帧在线遮挡强度预测；3) 将真值和预测遮挡强度注入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合和检测头。

Result: 在两个自建无人机多模态数据集SI3D-DI和SI3D-DII上，CAMF-Det在所有难度等级上达最优性能，hard级别BEV-mAP分别提升9.43%和4.88%。

Conclusion: 显式遮挡先验建模与利用能有效提升无人机场景下鲁棒的多模态3D检测性能。

Abstract: Multimodal 3D object detection based on LiDAR and cameras has demonstrated excellent performance in ground-vehicle scenarios, but has not been explored for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms. In UAV top-down scenes, frequent groundobject occlusion dominated by tree canopies causes spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Existing multimodal fusion frameworks neither explicitly model such ground-object occlusion nor embed occlusion awareness into the detection pipeline, limiting their performance in occluded UAV scenes. To address these challenges, we propose CAMF-Det, a closure-aware multimodal fusion framework for LiDAR-camera 3D object detection on UAV platforms, which derives dual-modal occlusion intensity through physics-inspired modeling and embeds them as priors throughout the detection pipeline. First, a dual-modal closure modeling module explicitly constructs occlusion intensity ground truth for both modalities offline via a Beer-Lambert-inspired formulation and building-mask correction. Second, using these ground-truth maps as supervision, a dual-modal prediction network converts the offline modeling results into online occlusion intensity predictions under single-frame inference. Third, both ground-truth and predicted occlusion intensity are injected into data augmentation, feature encoding, multimodal fusion, and detection head, enabling adaptive detection under spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Experiments on two self-built UAV-based multimodal datasets, SI3D-DI and SI3D-DII, demonstrate that CAMF-Det achieves the best performance across all difficulty levels, with hard-level mAP$_{\mathrm{BEV}}$ improvements of 9.43% and 4.88% over the best competing methods, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of explicit occlusion prior modeling and exploitation for robust multimodal 3D detection in UAV scenes.

</details>


### [155] [Ultra Flash: Scaling Real-Time Streaming Video Generation to High Resolutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09150)
*Luxury,Jie Huang,Zihao Fan,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yuming Li,Jun-hao Zhuang,Zeyue Xue,Siming Fu,Haoran Li,Mingchen Zhong,Guohui Zhang,Shichen Ma,Yijun Liu,Jiaqi Shi,Yanwen Ma,Yaofeng Su,Haoyu Wang,Yaowei Li,Songchun Zhang,Weiyang Jin,Yuxuan Bian,Shiyi Zhang,Haojun Xu,Shuai Lu,Xin Han,Wei Tang,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ultra Flash是一个级联流式框架，能够在单GPU上实现实时高分辨率视频生成（1K分辨率下约30 FPS，2K分辨率下约18 FPS），通过三个关键贡献解决了低分辨率到高分辨率的实时生成挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型虽然流式质量出色，但仅限于低分辨率（如480P），缺乏高效、可扩展的实时高分辨率视频生成方案。

Method: (1) 架构保留的T2V-to-TV2V超分辨率训练范式与面向AIGC的数据退化流程；(2) 因果流式潜变量上采样器与高分辨率解码器；(3) 级联高分辨率流式视频生成优化方案，包括混合奖励增强的稀疏因果化、单步蒸馏、级联流式自强制偏好优化及动态缓存管理。

Result: 在单GPU上实现1K分辨率约30 FPS、2K分辨率约18 FPS的实时生成，达到最先进的视觉质量和优越的效率。

Conclusion: Ultra Flash可靠地生成超高分辨率流式视频，同时保持最先进的视觉质量和效率，填补了实时高分辨率视频生成这一基础性开放挑战的空白。

Abstract: While recent autoregressive video diffusion models achieve remarkable streaming quality, they remain confined to low resolutions (e.g., 480P), leaving efficient, scalable, real-time high-resolution video generation a fundamental open challenge. To bridge this gap, we present Ultra Flash, a cascaded streaming framework capable of real-time high-resolution video generation. Ultra Flash achieves ~30 FPS at 1K resolution and ~18 FPS at 2K resolution on a single GPU through three key contributions: (1) an architecture-preserving T2V-to-TV2V super-resolution training paradigm coupled with an AIGC-oriented data degradation pipeline that effectively preserves the generative capability of the base model, enabling enhanced high-resolution detail when cascaded after mainstream low-resolution generative models; (2) a causal streaming latent upsampler paired with a high-resolution decoder, which enhances spatiotemporal coherence while enabling efficient latent spatial scaling and precise high-resolution decoding with negligible computational overhead; and (3) a cascade high-resolution streaming video generation optimization scheme that first performs hybrid-reward-enhanced sparse causalization and single-step distillation of the super-resolution model, then introduces cascaded streaming self-forcing preference optimization with dynamic cache management, jointly enhancing overall coherence, improving quality, and enabling real-time high-resolution streaming video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ultra Flash reliably produces ultra-high-resolution streaming video while maintaining state-of-the-art visual quality and superior efficiency.

</details>


### [156] [OmniGen-AR: AutoRegressive Any-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09156)
*Junke Wang,Xun Wang,Qiushan Guo,Peize Sun,Weilin Huang,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniGen-AR 提出统一的自回归框架，通过共享视觉分词器和解耦因果注意力机制，实现文本、空间信号、视觉上下文等多种条件到图像的生成，在多个基准上达到SOTA或竞争性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视觉生成模型通常仅支持单一模态条件（如文本），限制其在需要多种控制信号（空间、视觉上下文等）的现实场景中的应用。因此，作者希望构建一个统一框架，支持任意条件到图像的生成。

Method: 1) 通过共享视觉分词器将各种视觉条件离散化，结合文本分词器处理文本提示，实现多模态条件输入；2) 提出解耦因果注意力（DCA），将完整序列的因果掩码分离为条件因果注意力和内容因果注意力，作为训练时的正则化项防止条件令牌向内容令牌的信息泄漏，推理时仍使用标准的下一令牌预测。

Result: 在GenEval上达到0.63，VBench上达到80.02，在文本到图像生成、分割到图像、深度到图像、图像编辑、帧预测、文本到视频生成等多个任务上取得SOTA或具有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: OmniGen-AR证明了统一自回归框架在灵活、高保真视觉生成中的有效性，通过简单的架构和优化目标支持多条件输入，为任意到图像生成提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated strong potential in visual generation, offering superior performance with simple architectures and optimization objectives. However, existing methods are typically limited to single-modality conditions, e.g., text, restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that demand image synthesis from diverse controls. In this work, we present OmniGen-AR, a unified autoregressive framework for Any-to-Image generation. By discretizing various visual conditions through a shared visual tokenizer and text prompts with a text tokenizer, OmniGen-AR supports a broad spectrum of conditional inputs within a single model, including text (text-to-image generation), spatial signals (segmentation-to-image and depth-to-image), and visual context (image editing, frame prediction, and text-to-video generation). To mitigate the risk of information leakage from condition tokens to content tokens, we introduce Disentangled Causal Attention (DCA), which separates the full-sequence causal mask into condition causal attention and content causal attention. It serves as a training-time regularizer without affecting the standard next-token prediction during inference. With this design, OmniGen-AR achieves new state-of-the-art or at least competitive results across a range of benchmark, e.g., 0.63 on GenEval and 80.02 on VBench, demonstrating its effectiveness in flexible and high-fidelity visual generation.

</details>


### [157] [Zero-Parameter Geometric Gating for Temporally Stable Low-Altitude UAV Video Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09162)
*Jingpu Yang,Fengxian Ji,Zhengzhao Lai,Juanfan Wu,Mingxuan Cui,Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种零参数几何门控机制，利用RANSAC单应性内点比率在16×16空间网格上为每个区域选择单应性或光流变换，再通过语义相似性传播融合，在无额外学习参数条件下提升低空无人机视频语义分割的时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空无人机视频语义分割需要时间一致性，但稠密光流在平面区域（无人机航拍图像的主要组成部分）会引入空间结构化噪声，现有方法难以有效处理这种噪声。

Method: 提出零参数几何门控：在16×16空间网格上计算RANSAC单应性内点比率，通过中位数阈值做二值决策，为每个区域路由到单应性变换或光流变换；最后通过语义相似性传播（SSP）层融合。

Result: 在合成UAVid数据集上，SegFormer-b2和Hiera-S+UPerNet两种架构分别获得+4.24%和+4.91% mIoU提升；机制诊断表明平面区域光流残差存在空间自相关（Moran's I=0.32, p<0.001），可预测边界不稳定性（Spearman ρ=0.66），硬性化在单应性有效区域将时间一致性从62%恢复至92%（+29.5pp）。

Conclusion: 零参数几何门控能有效过滤平面区域的光流结构噪声，通过简单的统计阈值决策显著提升无人机视频语义分割的时间一致性，且几乎不增加参数量。

Abstract: Video semantic segmentation for low-altitude UAVs requires temporal consistency, yet dense optical flow introduces spatially structured noise in the planar regions that dominate aerial imagery. We propose a zero-parameter geometric gate that uses RANSAC homography inlier ratios on a $16\times16$ spatial grid to route each region to either homography or optical flow warp before fusion via Semantic Similarity Propagation. The gate requires no learned parameters -- only a median-threshold binary decision on RANSAC statistics -- adding only 211K trainable parameters (the SSP fusion layer) to a frozen backbone. On synthetic UAVid, the method achieves +4.24--4.91\% mIoU improvement over base models across two architectures (SegFormer-b2 and Hiera-S+UPerNet). Mechanism diagnostics reveal that flow residuals in planar regions are spatially autocorrelated (Moran's I = 0.32, $p < 0.001$), predict boundary instability (Spearman $ρ= 0.66$), and that rigidification recovers temporal consistency from 62\% to 92\% (+29.5pp) in homography-valid regions.

</details>


### [158] [Vision-Language Guided Hyperspectral Object Tracking via Semantics Fusion and Contextual Template Updating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09167)
*Rui Yao,Yuhong Zhang,Kunyang Sun,Hancheng Zhu,Jiaqi Zhao,Zhiwen Shao,Abdulmotaleb El Saddik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLHTrack提出了一种高光谱视觉-语言联合跟踪框架，通过语言引导的波段选择模块（LBSM）解决光谱冗余问题，并利用动态模板更新模块（DTUM）应对目标形变，在HOT2023和HOT2024上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱目标跟踪中光谱冗余导致模型泛化能力受限，且动态场景中目标因遮挡、光照变化等出现剧烈外观变化，现有时序建模方法难以应对帧间大形变问题。

Method: 1) 语言引导波段选择模块（LBSM）：利用大语言模型描述建立语义-光谱映射，筛选判别性光谱特征；2) 多模态视觉-语言融合模块：整合视觉与语言嵌入，学习跨模态表示；3) 动态模板更新模块（DTUM）：基于Mamba的选择性状态空间建模，学习帧间依赖关系以动态更新模板特征。

Result: 在HOT2023和HOT2024数据集上，VLHTrack优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 引入语言先验和动态模板更新策略能有效提升高光谱目标跟踪的性能，验证了视觉-语言联合范式在该任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Hyperspectral object tracking (HOT) leverages the rich spectral information provided by hyperspectral videos (HSVs), offering substantial potential for object tracking. However, efficiently extracting and exploiting spectral information from redundant spectral bands remains a fundamental challenge, which severely limits model generalization and tracking performance. Moreover, in dynamic scenes, targets often experience drastic appearance variations due to factors such as occlusion and illumination changes. These variations lead to large deformations between the current frame and the template. Such discrepancies pose major challenges for existing temporal modeling approaches. In this work, we propose VLHTrack, a novel hyperspectral vision-language (VL) joint tracking framework. Specifically, we incorporate language priors to address the fundamental challenge of spectral redundancy by designing a Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM). By leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) descriptions, LBSM establishes a semantic-to-spectral mapping that mitigates redundancy and accentuates discriminative spectral features. A Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module is then employed to seamlessly integrate visual and linguistic embeddings, harnessing their complementary advantages to learn coherent cross-modal representations. To address target deformation in long-term sequences, we propose a dynamic update template feature strategy implemented via the Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM) module. By leveraging selective state space modeling, DTUM learns inter-frame dependencies to update template feature, ensuring efficient template feature evolution guided by temporal context. Experiments on HOT2023 and HOT2024 demonstrate that VLHTrack outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [159] [Bidirectional Small-Granularity Search between Code and Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07519)
*Marco A. Valenzuela-Escárcega,Enrique Noriega-Atala,Gus Hahn-Powell,Clayton T. Morrison,Mihai Surdeanu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了代码与文本之间的双向小粒度搜索任务，构建了包含GPT-4自动生成训练数据和人工标注测试数据的大规模数据集，并提出了一种跨四个子任务共享编码器的模块化方法，在域内取得良好效果，在域外也有令人鼓舞的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在科学出版物中的文本与对应代码片段之间建立直接链接，从而支持对科学方法的更好、更快速的理解。

Method: 提出了一个模块化方法，跨四个不同子任务共享编码器，学习双向的答案起止位置预测。

Result: 在域内数据集上取得良好结果，在域外数据集上也取得了令人鼓舞的结果。

Conclusion: 使用自动生成数据解决该任务是可行的，但仍有值得探索的未来工作空间。

Abstract: We introduce the novel task of bidirectional small-granularity search between code and text, where the queries are small snippets of text or code and the results are also small fragments of the opposite modality, i.e., code or text. This task establishes direct links between text in scientific publications and corresponding code segments, in support of better and faster understanding of scientific methods. We introduce a large dataset for the proposed task that includes a training partition with textual descriptions of code generated automatically using GPT-4, and three testing partitions, one in-domain and two out-of-domain (OOD) that contain manually-annotated data as well as material from other domains. We also propose a modular approach to address this task. Our approach shares an encoder across four different subtasks that learn start/end of answer spans in both directions. We show that our method achieves good results in-domain, and encouraging results OOD. This suggests that addressing this task with automatically-generated data is possible, but there is exciting future work to be done.

</details>


### [160] [TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07520)
*Yirong Zeng,Yufei Liu,Xiao Ding,Yutai Hou,Yuxian Wang,Wu Ning,Haonan Song,Dandan Tu,Qixun Zhang,Yuxiang He,Bibo Cai,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对指令遵循任务中不可验证约束的奖励设计问题，提出TinyJudge框架：通过集成多个约0.6B参数的小型语言模型作为奖励模型，蒸馏前沿模型知识实现轻量级高精度评估，在五个基准上平均性能提升约10%，奖励精度提升12%，训练速度提升3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLHF方法使用LLM-as-a-judge评估不可验证约束（如语气），但存在严重的奖励黑客问题和较高的计算开销，成为指令遵循任务的主要瓶颈。

Method: 首先分析不可验证约束的泛化能力，发现特定约束具有高泛化模式；在此基础上提出TinyJudge框架，集成多个约0.6B参数的专用小语言模型，通过蒸馏前沿模型知识为不可验证软约束提供奖励信号。

Result: 在五个基准上，TinyJudge平均性能提升约10%，奖励精度提升12%，训练总时间加速3倍。

Conclusion: TinyJudge为对齐LLM与不可验证的人类指令提供了一条可扩展且鲁棒的路径。

Abstract: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In this work, we first analyze the generalization capabilities of unverifiable constraints and discover that specific constraints exhibit distinct, high-generalization patterns. Motivated by this, we propose TinyJudge, a framework that employs an ensemble of specialized tiny language models ($\sim0.6B$) to provide rewards for soft constraints. By distilling expertise from frontier models into these tiny models, it achieves high-precision, lightweight evaluation. Extensive evaluations across five benchmarks demonstrate that TinyJudge outperforms the baselines by $\sim10\%$ in average performance and $12\%$ in reward precision. Crucially, it also achieves a $3\times$ speedup in total training time. Our work provides a scalable and robust path for aligning LLMs with unverifiable human instructions.

</details>


### [161] [Evaluating Hallucinations in Domain-Adapted Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07521)
*Sanchita Porwal,Sai Prasath S,Xingjian Bi,Madelyn Scandlen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究探究了领域适配大语言模型中幻觉现象，通过对Llama-2模型使用Lamini数据集进行微调实验，发现模型在记忆、回忆和推理任务中表现出对训练数据的依赖，但在处理新领域特定信息时存在幻觉问题，倾向于过生成额外信息，揭示了微调方法在缓解领域适应中幻觉的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域适配的大语言模型在微调后容易出现幻觉（生成无意义或不忠实的内容），这一问题在模型被微调到专业领域时尤为突出，亟需系统性地探究其表现和局限性。

Method: 采用Llama-2模型在Lamini数据集上进行微调，设计了一系列实验测试模型的记忆、回忆和推理能力，对比模型在新问答对和领域特定信息上的表现差异。

Result: 模型在类似训练数据的任务上表现良好，但准确推理和回忆新领域特定信息的能力受限，导致幻觉；模型倾向于提供正确但附带额外信息的内容，表现出过生成倾向；模型在处理领域特定查询时表现较弱。

Conclusion: 仅依赖微调的方法在缓解领域适应中的幻觉问题存在显著局限性，需要开发更鲁棒的方法来适配大语言模型到专业领域。

Abstract: This study investigates the phenomenon of hallucinations in domain-adapted Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on the fine-tuning of the Llama-2 model with the Lamini dataset. Hallucinations, or the generation of nonsensical or unfaithful content by LLMs, pose a significant challenge, especially when these models are fine-tuned with domain-specific data. Our methodology involves a series of experiments testing memorization, recall, and reasoning capabilities of the fine-tuned LLM, comparing its performance on novel question-answer pairs and domain-specific information. We found that while the model shows proficiency in tasks similar to its training data, its capability to accurately reason about and recall new domain-specific information remains limited, leading to instances of hallucination. The model demonstrates a tendency to provide correct answers with extra information, suggesting an inclination toward over-generation. These results suggest important limitations of fine-tuning-only approaches for mitigating hallucinations when adapting LLMs to specialized domains and underscore the need for more robust methods in adapting LLMs to specialized domains. The study also provides insights into the varying performance of LLMs on different types of information, revealing a comparative weakness in handling domain-specific queries.

</details>


### [162] [Community-Specific Slang and Entity Detection via Semantic Shift in Fine-Tuned Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07522)
*Julia Kruk,Sanchita Porwal,Amitrajit Bhattacharjee,Mansi Phute*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种无监督方法，通过衡量LLM微调前后词向量的余弦相似度来识别语义偏移最大的词汇，从而解析网络社区中的俚语、特有实体和民俗用语。在3个Reddit子版块数据上微调DistilRoBERTa，证明底部10%分位的词汇具有社区特异性，而顶部10%分位的词汇语义具有普适性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以自动识别和解析网络社区中的俚语、特有实体和民俗用语，缺乏无监督且高效的检测手段。

Method: 1) 在社区特定文本语料上微调预训练LLM（DistilRoBERTa）；2) 计算基础模型与微调模型对同一词的表征向量之间的余弦相似度，定义语义偏移量；3) 对词表内所有词的余弦相似度分布建模，取底部10%分位词作为社区特有词汇。

Result: 底部10%分位词汇成功解析了社区特有的俚语、实体和民俗用语；顶部10%分位词汇则承载了相对普适的语义。

Conclusion: 通过衡量LLM微调前后的语义偏移，可在无监督条件下有效识别网络社区中的领域特异性词汇。

Abstract: We propose an unsupervised method of resolving slang, unique entities, and folklore from online communities by isolating words in the lexicon that have the highest magnitude of semantic shift. Semantic shift is defined as the evolution of a word's encoded representation as a result of fine-tuning a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) on a community-specific text corpus. This value is inversely proportional to the cosine similarity between the base model's encoded representation of a word, and a fine-tuned model's encoded representation. We fine-tune the DistilRoBERTa model on text corpora collected from 3 Reddit subreddits (r/Technology, r/Gaming, r/WorldofWarcraft), model a distribution of cosine similarity over the lexicon, and show that one can successfully resolve words that have unique significance to the community by pulling data in the bottom 10-percentile. In contrast, we show that data in the top 10-percentile consist of words that carry relatively universal semantics.

</details>


### [163] [Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for the Nepali Legal Domain Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07523)
*Samir Wagle,Abiral Adhikari,Reewaj Khanal,Batsal Bhandari,Prashant Manandhar,Praveen Acharya,Bal Krishna Bal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次将检索增强生成（RAG）模型应用于尼泊尔语法律问答，利用BM25和E5模型从尼泊尔法律文献中检索案例，实现了91%的top-1精确率和74%的答案可信度，为低资源语言法律AI系统提供了有效基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（如尼泊尔语）的法律领域因数据稀缺，缺乏大规模语言模型训练数据，导致法律问答AI系统发展滞后，而高资源语言（如英语）已广泛采用AI技术。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 使用BM25对分块文档进行检索，并结合多语言E5-large模型；采用检索增强生成（RAG）管道，从Nepal Kanun Patrika数字档案中提取案例法用于尼泊尔语法律问答。

Result: BM25检索达到91%的top-1精确率，多语言E5-large模型达到75%；生成答案的groundedness为74%，自动评判模型评估的truthfulness为85%，人工评估的truthfulness为84%，成功回答生成率达92%。

Conclusion: RAG管道能有效解决低资源语言法律问答的差距，为尼泊尔法律领域可靠AI系统的建立提供了基础。

Abstract: Legal domains in high-resource languages like English have widely adopted artificial intelligence for legal question answering. However, data scarcity in low resource languages such as Nepali has limited the training of large language models on Nepali legal texts. This study presents the first application of a Retrieval Augmented Generation based model for Nepali legal question answering using case laws extracted from the Nepal Kanun Patrika digital archive. Using BM25 on chunked documents, the approach achieved a top precision at one of 91 percent, and up to 75 percent with the multilingual E5 large model. Evaluation of generated answers showed 74 percent groundedness, 85 percent truthfulness according to an automated judge model, and 84 percent human evaluated truthfulness when using BM25 document retrieval, with a 92 percent successful answer generation rate. These results demonstrate that the RAG pipeline can effectively address the gap in legal question answering for low resource languages and provide a foundation for reliable AI systems in the Nepali legal domain.

</details>


### [164] [ABLE: Representing and Mapping LLMs via Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07524)
*Zirui Wang,Yusen Hou,Shaofeng Liang,Bowen Tian,Yanlin Zhang,Wenshuo Chen,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ABLE框架，利用梯度归因构建大模型表示，无训练且跨分词器，在239个开源LLM上实现关系预测、模型路由和基准分数预测的竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM表示方法无法有效处理异构、文档匮乏的模型生态系统：内部参数方法受限于结构异构，外部输出方法容易混淆相似行为且难以对齐不同分词器。

Method: ABLE通过聚合基于梯度的特征归因，并采用无分词器的词级对齐策略，构建模型表示，捕捉模型特定的输入敏感性模式。

Result: 在239个开源LLM上的实验表明，该无训练方法在关系预测、模型路由和基准分数预测任务上达到或超越现有方法。

Conclusion: ABLE提供了一种可扩展、无需训练的模型表示方法，兼具理论稳定性保证（Lipschitz连续参数-嵌入映射与有限样本收敛性）和实证有效性。

Abstract: The explosive growth of large language models (LLMs) has created a heterogeneous and poorly documented ecosystem, making systematic model comparison increasingly important for provenance auditing, security analysis, and model selection. Existing representation methods struggle to address this setting efficiently. Approaches analyzing internal parameters are powerful when architectures are compatible, but face scalability barriers under structural heterogeneity, while methods relying on external outputs may conflate models with similar behaviors and are difficult to align in richer output spaces across different tokenizers. To bridge this gap, we propose ABLE (Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding), a framework that leverages the interpretability space to construct model representations. By aggregating gradient-based feature attributions via a tokenizer-agnostic word-level alignment, ABLE captures model-specific input-sensitivity patterns rather than only surface-level outputs. Beyond empirical utility, we provide a stability analysis showing that, under standard regularity assumptions for differentiable Transformer-style models, ABLE induces a Lipschitz-continuous parameter-to-embedding map with finite-sample convergence guarantees. Extensive experiments on 239 open-source LLMs demonstrate that our training-free approach achieves competitive or superior performance in relation prediction, model routing, and benchmark score prediction.

</details>


### [165] [Implicit Causal Graph Construction in Text via Chain Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07525)
*Liesbeth Allein,Marie-Francine Moens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究从文本中构建隐式因果图，利用LLM推断观察到的因果对之间的潜在中间因果事件，比较了端到端构建、因果链发现聚合及迭代扩展等方法，并探索了多LLM协作的群体智慧策略，最后基于1,560个科学验证的因果对数据库评估了因果关系的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果图构建依赖文本中显式定义的因果事件，而现实中的因果关系往往是隐式的，中间存在大量未明确表述的因果环节。本文旨在利用LLM推断这些潜在中间事件，从而构建更完整的隐式因果图。

Method: 本文对比了两种主要方法：1) 端到端的因果图构建；2) 将任务分解为因果链发现，包括通过聚合推断的因果链或通过迭代搜索逐步扩展部分链来构建图。此外，还探索了群体智能扩展方法，在事后聚合和协作推理设置中访问多个LLM的因果知识。

Result: 构建了一个包含1,560个科学验证因果对的手工数据库，用于评估推理出的因果关系的有效性。该评估方法被证明是可靠、资源高效且可迁移的。

Conclusion: 本文提出的基于数据库的评估方法适用于缺乏真实因果图标注的场景，为隐式因果图构建提供了可靠的评估范式，不同构建方法之间存在明确的权衡关系。

Abstract: Causal graphs in text are typically populated by observable, predefined events. In contrast, we study implicit causal graph construction from text by treating each described cause-effect pair as the begin- and endpoint of an underlying latent causal graph and using large language models (LLMs) to infer intermediate causal events. We compare end-to-end graph construction with methods that frame the task as causal chain discovery. In the latter, graphs are built either by aggregating inferred chains or by progressively expanding partial chains through an iterative search process. We further explore Wisdom of the Crowd extensions that access causal knowledge from multiple LLMs in post-hoc aggregation and collaborative inference settings. We analyze trade-offs among these approaches and evaluate the validity of inferred causal relations using a manually curated database of 1,560 scientifically validated causal pairs. This database-based evaluation is proposed as reliable, resource-efficient, and transferable to settings where ground-truth graphs are unavailable.

</details>


### [166] [GraphLoRA: Structure-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07526)
*Lin Mu,Guoji Wang,Li Ni,Lei Sang,Zhize Wu,Peiquan Jin,Yiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GraphLoRA通过在低秩适配路径中嵌入可训练图消息传递网络，实现图结构与文本语义的深度融合，在LLM推荐任务中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法将协同信息视为静态输入，未能捕获高阶关系依赖，难以有效对齐LLM文本语义与协同信号。

Method: 提出GraphLoRA框架，将低秩适配从独立适配泛化为结构感知传播，在LoRA路径中嵌入可训练图消息传递网络，使结构信号通过参数空间传播并指导参数更新。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，GraphLoRA超越现有基于LLM的推荐方法，实现了更好的泛化性能，并在结构推理能力与计算效率之间取得有效平衡。

Conclusion: GraphLoRA通过结构感知的低秩适配机制，成功实现了图结构与文本语义的深度整合，为LLM推荐任务中的协同信号融合提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation (LLMRec) due to their powerful reasoning and generalization abilities. However, effectively aligning the textual semantics modeled by LLMs with the collaborative signals remains a key challenge. Existing methods either translate collaborative information into textual prompts or inject pre-trained embeddings into the LLM, both of which treat structural information as static input and fail to capture high-order relational dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphLoRA, a novel framework that generalizes low-rank adaptation from independent to structure-aware propagation. GraphLoRA embeds a trainable graph message-passing network within the low-rank adaptation pathway, enabling structural signals to propagate through the parameter space. This design allows collaborative topology to explicitly guide parameter updates, fostering deep integration between graph-structured and textual semantic information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that GraphLoRA not only outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based recommendation methods but also achieves superior generalization, effectively balancing structural reasoning capability with computational efficiency. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}.

</details>


### [167] [Post-training is (Massive) Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07527)
*Michael Hassid,Yossi Adi,Roy Schwartz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出现有的LLM后训练范式（SFT+RL）本质上是回归到了BERT时代的"预训练-微调"模式，通过实验证明后训练主要起到分布拟合作用，并提出应转向"学会如何学习"的训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者观察到当前LLM训练范式（大规模后训练）与BERT时代的微调模式高度相似，质疑这种方法的局限性，并希望通过实验证明后训练本质上是一种分布拟合机制，而非真正的通用能力提升。

Method: 从历史视角梳理LLM发展不同阶段，进行对比实验：将预训练模型与随机初始化模型分别在推理数据集上微调，并在数学和代码基准上评估性能。

Result: 从零开始后训练的模型能够取得非平凡的性能表现，表明后训练主要起到分布拟合的作用，而非依赖预训练知识的深度泛化。

Conclusion: 当前后训练方法本质上是分布拟合机制，发展真正通用模型需要超越针对预定义行为的大量后训练，转向让模型"学会如何学习"的训练范式。

Abstract: The prevailing paradigm for training LLMs has evolved to rely on a massive post-training phase consisting of SFT and RL. In this position paper, we argue that this methodology effectively marks a reversion to the ``pre-train then fine-tune'' approach of the BERT era, explicitly tailoring models to the desired behaviors and specific benchmarks on which they are evaluated. We begin with a historical overview of LLMs, describing the different phases of the LLM evolution. We argue that the current landscape is remarkably similar to the early days of LLMs, where task performance heavily relied on fitting the models to in-distribution datasets. To empirically demonstrate this, we compare pre-trained models to randomly initialized ones, by fine-tuning both variants on modern reasoning datasets and evaluating them on competitive math and code benchmarks. We show that models post-trained from scratch yield highly non-trivial performance. Our findings suggest that current post-training methodologies function primarily as a distribution-fitting mechanism. We finish by positing that developing generally capable models and systems requires moving beyond extensive post-training for predefined behaviors, shifting instead toward training procedures where models ``learn how to learn''.

</details>


### [168] [BEACON: Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-Model Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07528)
*Naveen Bera,Pulijala Sai Nikhila,Kondaguduru Abhiram,Shaik Gayaz Ali,Shoaib Sadiq Salehmohamed,Shaik Mohammed Omar,Jinal Prashant Thakkar,Hansika Aredla,Shalmali Ayachit*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BEACON，一种仅基于模型输出的黑盒幻觉检测框架，通过提取31维特征向量（包括NLI语义熵、嵌入几何、思维链一致性、释义稳定性）并训练梯度提升分类器，在7个基准上达到0.8123 AUROC，优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型中的幻觉问题（生成事实错误或未经证实的内容）严重阻碍了其可靠部署，现有方法要么需要访问模型内部表征，要么依赖外部知识库，缺乏纯黑盒场景下的有效检测手段。

Method: BEACON框架包含：（1）结构化多轮生成提取31维特征向量，整合NLI语义熵、嵌入几何特征、思维链一致性、释义稳定性信号；（2）基于梯度提升树的分类器在7,617个标注样本上训练；（3）提出5次调用的高效变体以支持实际部署。

Result: 在7个基准上AUROC达0.8123±0.0102（95%CI: 0.7632-0.8251），超越独立语义熵（+0.2298）和SelfCheckGPT式一致性基线（+0.2457）。5次调用高效变体达0.7795 AUROC。

Conclusion: 幻觉本质上是一个多维现象，需要组合多种不确定性信号进行有效检测；BEACON实现了无需内部表示或外部知识的纯黑盒幻觉检测，具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Hallucination in large language models (LLMs), defined as the generation of factually incorrect or unsupported content, remains a critical barrier to reliable deployment. We present BEACON (Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-model hallucination detectiON), a black-box hallucination detection framework that operates purely on model outputs without requiring access to internal representations or external knowledge bases. BEACON extracts a 31-dimensional feature vector from structured multi-pass generation, integrating NLI-based semantic entropy, embedding geometry, chain-of-thought consistency, and paraphrase stability signals. A gradient-boosted classifier trained on 7,617 labeled examples across seven benchmarks achieves 0.8123 +/- 0.0102 AUROC (95% CI: 0.7632-0.8251), outperforming standalone semantic entropy (+0.2298) and SelfCheckGPT-style consistency baselines (+0.2457). Feature importance analysis shows that hallucination is inherently multi-dimensional, requiring combined uncertainty signals. An efficient 5-call variant achieves 0.7795 AUROC, enabling practical deployment across black-box LLM APIs.

</details>


### [169] [CAPruner: Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner for Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07529)
*Shengli Zhou,Xiangchen Wang,Guanhua Chen,Feng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对3D视觉-语言任务中场景图关系推理存在的高计算成本和冗余关系问题，提出基于概念邻近的场景图剪枝器（CAPruner），通过融合模糊语义相关性与空间邻近性筛选关键空间关系，在不需关系级标注的情况下提升LLM在3D-VL任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景图剪枝方法主要依赖空间邻近性，常移除与任务相关的重要关系，影响可靠的空间推理。需要一种能保留与特定3D-VL任务最相关的空间关系的剪枝方法。

Method: 提出CAPruner，融合模糊语义相关性（fuzzy semantic relevance）与空间邻近性（spatial proximity）来估计关系的重要性，从而实现任务特定场景下的关键关系选择。为避免关系级标注的高昂成本，通过监督每个节点入射边的聚合得分进行训练。

Result: 实验表明CAPruner能有效保留空间推理所必需的关系，显著提升LLM在3D-VL任务上的性能。

Conclusion: 通过语义与空间信息的融合剪枝，可以在降低计算成本的同时增强3D-VL空间推理的可靠性，是一种无需关系级标注的高效场景图压缩方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to 3D vision-language (3D-VL) tasks, which require spatial reasoning to identify target objects relative to anchors. Scene graphs are commonly employed to represent such relations, but reasoning over complete graphs incurs high token costs and computational inefficiencies, motivating the need for pruning. Existing pruning methods primarily rely on spatial proximity and often remove task-relevant relations, thereby undermining reliable spatial reasoning. To address these limitations, we derive a key requirement for scene graph pruning: preserving spatial relations that are most pertinent to the specific 3D-VL task. Guided by this insight, we propose the Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner (CAPruner). CAPruner integrates fuzzy semantic relevance with spatial proximity to estimate the importance of relations, enabling the selection of critical relations in a task-specific context. Moreover, to avoid costly relation-level annotations, CAPruner is trained by supervising the aggregated scores of each node's incident edges. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAPruner effectively preserves relations essential for spatial reasoning, leading to substantial performance improvements of LLMs on 3D-VL tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/fz-zsl/CAPruner.

</details>


### [170] [Finding New Connections between Concepts from Medline Database Incorporating Domain Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07530)
*Yang Weikang,Chowdhury S. M. Mazharul Hoque,Jin Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文讨论了基于Don R. Swanson的ABC模型改进的自适应文献发现模型，用于发现医学概念之间隐藏的关联关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数字世界中，数据看似独立实则通过共同主题相互关联，因此需要一种方法发现概念间隐藏的连接关系。

Method: 基于Don R. Swanson的ABC文献发现模型进行改进，提出自适应模型，通过寻找两个看似无关概念（A和C）之间的共同中间概念B来建立连接。

Result: 该自适应模型能够有效发现医学概念之间的隐藏关联。

Conclusion: 改进的ABC模型可用于医学领域的概念发现，帮助揭示表面上无关但实际存在间接关联的医学概念之间的联系。

Abstract: In this digital world, data is everything and significantly impacts our everyday lives. Interestingly, in this small world, everything is part of an ecosystem, where everything is connected, directly or indirectly. The same thing happens to data as well. In most cases, it may seem like a particular topic does not have any connection with another one, but in reality, they are connected through a mutually related topic. Therefore, in this research, we will discuss an adaptive model modified from the ABC model by Don R. Swanson, a Literature-Based Discovery (LBD) Model, to find the hidden connections between Concepts of Interest. The model demonstrates that two topics, A and C are different and have no relationship. But they have a common topic, B that can be used to connect topics A and C This famous model will be used in this discussion to connect Medical Concepts.

</details>


### [171] [mllm-shap: A Shapley Value Explainability Platform for Text-Audio Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07531)
*Jakub Muszyński,Paweł Pozorski,Maria Ganzha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了mllm-shap，一个开源的Python框架，将Shapley值可解释性从纯文本大语言模型扩展到处理文本和音频输入的多模态大语言模型，解决了模态感知掩码、多轮对话追踪和语音对齐分词三个关键挑战，并实现了五种SV估算策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Shapley值可解释性方法主要针对纯文本LLM，缺乏适用于处理联合文本-音频输入的多模态LLM的完整可解释性框架。

Method: 提出mllm-shap框架，包含：(1)模态感知联盟掩码，管理离散文本token与密集音频编码器帧的交错处理；(2)多轮对话追踪，利用逐token元数据维护角色和模态上下文；(3)语音对齐分词分组，将联盟空间减少10-50倍；实现了五种SV估算策略，包括互补贡献估计器。

Result: 语音对齐分词分组技术将联盟空间减少10-50倍，使长音频的SV估计在计算上可行；互补贡献估计器相比标准蒙特卡洛基线表现出更优的收敛性。

Conclusion: mllm-shap是首个公开可用的、提供完整可复现管道的框架，用于文本-音频多模态大语言模型的Shapley值可解释性，以pip包形式提供并包含交互式Web GUI。

Abstract: We introduce mllm-shap, an open-source Python framework designed to extend Shapley Value (SV) explainability from text-only Large Language Models to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) processing joint text and audio inputs. While text-based attribution is well-studied, mllm-shap addresses three critical challenges unique to the multimodal regime:
  (1) Modality-aware coalition masking, which manages the interleaved processing of discrete text tokens and dense audio encoder frames.
  (2) Multi-turn conversation tracking, utilizing per-token metadata to maintain role and modality context.
  (3) Phonetic alignment-based token grouping, a novel technique that reduces the coalition space by 10x to 50x, rendering SV estimation computationally feasible for long-form audio.
  The platform implements five SV estimation strategies, including a Complementary Contributions (CC) estimator with Neyman-optimal allocation that demonstrates superior convergence over standard Monte Carlo baselines. mllm-shap is provided as a pip-installable package featuring an interactive web-based GUI for granular attribution visualization. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly available framework providing a complete, reproducible pipeline for SV-based explainability in text-audio MLLMs.

</details>


### [172] [Principled Agent Debate: Adversarial Arbitration for Sycophancy Reduction in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07532)
*Sam Ryan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出原则性智能体辩论（PAD）架构，通过两个对立哲学倾向的模型进行身份剥离的盲目仲裁，显著降低RLHF训练带来的系统性谄媚偏差，在SycophancyEval上最高达48.5%准确率（vs单模型基线18.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF训练的模型存在系统性偏差，倾向于同意用户而非追求准确性（身份框架谄媚），现有方法无法有效缓解这一结构性问题。

Method: PAD架构：1）静态倾向调优——两个模型分别对立哲学倾向；2）身份剥离——合成前去除来源标识；3）单轮独立论证；4）盲目仲裁——实用主义综合器评估双方论点。评估了五个变体（AnCifer、DeWin、FeynStein、BurGal、Trident）。

Result: 所有PAD变体显著优于单模型基线（18.5%）和指令对立基线（29.0%），DeWin达48.5%（z=6.36, p<0.001）。变体间无显著差异。BurGal达53.0%但存在结构性偏向。约40%问题受预训练下限限制。

Conclusion: PAD有效缓解谄媚偏差，但受预训练知识下限约束；微调倾向模型是下一步方向。

Abstract: RLHF-trained models are systematically biased toward agreement over accuracy, a structural property of the training process. We present Principled Agent Debate (PAD), a multi-agent architecture that mitigates identity-framed sycophancy by arbitrating between two models tuned to opposing philosophical dispositions, with a pragmatist synthesizer evaluating both arguments blind to their origins. This paper evaluates a prompt-based instantiation of PAD. The key mechanisms are static dispositional tuning, identity stripping before synthesis, single-round independent argumentation, and blind arbitration. We evaluate five instantiations on 200 stratified questions from SycophancyEval. All PAD variants (AnCifer, DeWin, FeynStein, BurGal, Trident) significantly outperform the single-model baseline (18.5%) and instructed-opposition baseline (29.0%), with DeWin achieving 48.5% accuracy (z=6.36, p<0.001 versus both). The variants are not significantly different from each other at n=200. The BurGal variant achieves 53.0% but functions as an architectural validity check; its consensus/heterodox axis structurally favors the heterodox model on every benchmark question. A pre-training floor affects an estimated 40% of questions; fine-tuned disposition models are the identified next step.

</details>


### [173] [Bridging Traditional Explainability Methods and Multimodal Multilingual Models: An XAI-Based Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07533)
*Paweł Pozorski,Jakub Muszyński,Maria Ganzha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多模态Shapley值框架，结合高效估计策略和谱图引导的音素对齐方法，实现了文本-音频多模态大语言模型的归因解释，并开发了开源工具包，实验发现输入模态是归因波动的主要驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型能有效整合文本和音频，但其内部工作机制不透明；传统Shapley值方法扩展到多模态数据面临跨通道依赖、对话结构复杂和密集音频表示计算开销大等挑战。

Method: 形式化定义了多模态Shapley值框架，将离散文本token和对齐的音频片段视为协作特征；采用精确SV计算（低维）和采样近似（蒙特卡洛排列、Neyman最优分配分层抽样）保证计算可行性；提出谱图引导音素对齐（SGPA）预处理方法，将高频音频流映射到可解释的词级对齐片段。

Result: 实验表明输入模态是归因波动的主要驱动因素，标准句法重要性代理在跨语言多模态上下文中无法预测模型注意力。

Conclusion: 开源了模型无关的Python包和GUI工具，为多模态归因计算和交互可视化提供支持，揭示了多模态场景下现有归因方法的局限性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively integrate text and audio to interpret context in complex interactive dialogues. However, the internal mechanisms by which heterogeneous modalities influence model behavior remain opaque. While Shapley Values (SV) provide a robust, model-agnostic framework for local explainability in text-based NLP, their extension to multimodal data is hindered by cross-channel dependencies, intricate dialogue structures, and the prohibitive computational complexity of dense audio representations.
  In this work, we formalize a multimodal extension of the Shapley Value framework, treating discrete text tokens and aligned audio segments as cooperative features. To ensure computational feasibility, we deploy a suite of efficient estimation strategies: exact SV computation for low-dimensional inputs and sampling-based approximations - including Monte Carlo permutations and stratified sampling with Neyman-optimal allocation - to minimize variance under constrained computational budgets.
